name: Syaandi Warpriest (CR 5)
body:
SYAANDI WARPRIEST
CR 5

XP 1,600
Syaandi warpriest 6
CN Medium humanoid (syaandi)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+5 armor, +1 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural)
hp 43 (6d8+12)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +6; +2 vs. fear, +2 vs. poison, spells, and spell-like abilities
Defensive Abilities cornered fury, fearless, hardy

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 vicious longspear +9 (1d8+5 plus 2d6/×3)
Ranged mwk sling +6 (1d4+3)
Special Attacks blessings 6/day, channel negative energy 2/day (DC 14, 3d6), ferocity, fervor 4/day (2d6), sacred weapon (+1 1d8, 6 rounds/day)
Warpriest Spells Prepared (CL 6th; concentration +7)

2nd—boiling blood (DC 13), disfiguring touch (DC 13), hold person (DC 13)
1st—bane (DC 12), cause fear (DC 12), command (DC 12), doom (DC 12), ray of sickening (DC 12)
0 (at will)—create water, detect magic, purify food and drink (DC 11), read magic, spark (DC 11)

TACTICS

During Combat If the npc puts enough distance between himself and his warriors, he channels negative energy to damage his opponents. Thereafter, he makes Power Attacks using Furious Focus with his +1 longspear, activating his sacred weapon ability to enhance it with the vicious weapon property as a swift action.

Morale the npc and his warriors all fight to the death, counting upon their tear shards to resurrect them if they fall.

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 13, Con 12, Int 8, Wis 13, Cha 12
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 18 (18 vs. sunder)
Feats Cleave, Dodge, Furious Focus, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (longspear)
Skills Heal +5, Intimidate +7, Survival +6
Languages Syaandu
SQ blessings (strength: strength surge, war: war mind)
Gear potions of cure moderate wounds (2), +1 hide armor, +1 longspear, mwk sling with 15 bullets, tear shard, 45 gp
